messages:
sam-l: Paging — multiple load/warmup failures in us-west-2 affecting turing-xl-v2-quant instances. Alerts for serving-degraded-high (containers restarting, CUDA OOM, and occasional compile timeout). Anyone oncall?

incident-bot: Alert triggered: serving-degraded-high | cluster: us-west-2-hostgroup-06 | model: turing-xl-v2-quant | impacted pods: 12 | runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-warmup-issues

oncall-mike: I'm on it. Pausing new traffic to hostgroup-06, moving canary to other region. Will collect logs & stack traces.

maya-r: grabbing model-loader logs now. Seeing repeated deserialization errors then immediate `cudaMalloc` failures. Sample:
```
2026-03-12T18:12:03Z model-loader ERROR deserializing weights: unexpected EOF while reading tensor 'transformer.h.12.attn.qkv.weight'
2026-03-12T18:12:04Z runtime WARN compile timeout for model turing-xl-v2-quant (stage: kernel-optim) after 120s
2026-03-12T18:12:04Z runtime ERROR cudaMalloc returned 2 (out of memory)
```

kevin-i: Host-level metrics show GPU mem fragmentation + high pinned memory on host-06 nodes. No recent infra deploys. Any model changes today?

sam-l: We published a new quantization profile for turing-xl-v2-quant at 15:30; that could be related.

maya-r: That aligns — new quantized weights may be smaller on disk but deserialization path changed. Two failure modes: (1) corrupt/partial artifact -> deserialization EOF; (2) successful load but kernel compile/allocator fails causing CUDA OOM. Compile-timeouts happening when JIT tries new kernels.

ops-bot: Auto-action: rolled back model artifact version turing-xl-v2-quant@20260312 -> turing-xl-v2-quant@20260311 on affected hosts.

support-anna: CS update: three enterprise customers on dedicated nodes reported 502s around 18:13 PST. Emily-C (Customer Success) notified customers and opened tickets.

oncall-mike: Short mitigation plan:
- stop warmup jobs for turing-xl-v2-quant on hostgroup-06 (so they don't OOM repeatedly)
- fallback traffic to turing-xl-v2-fp16-1 on shared cluster
- enable skip-warmup for rolling loads to avoid JIT compile storm
- run `model-validate` on artifact replicas to check for corruption

kevin-i: I'll cordon + restart the GPU driver on host-06-03 (node with highest OOMs). That will evict pods briefly. ETA 6m.

maya-r: Implemented temporary config (duck tape) to set `WARMUP_ENABLED=false` for turing-xl-v2-quant in us-west-2. Command used:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/configs/models/turing-xl-v2-quant -d '{"WARMUP_ENABLED":false}'
```

kevin-i: GPU driver restart done on host-06-03. Node rejoined. Memory alloc patterns look better but still fragmentation. Recommend a gradual restart of remaining hosts after traffic drained.

maya-r: Verified one artifact copy failed integrity check (checksum mismatch). Propagating to all stores might be the root cause for deserialization EOFs. Starting artifact re-sync from blobstore.

oncall-mike: Traffic routed to fallback model. Monitoring latency & error rate. Will keep throttles in place to avoid cold-start thundering herd.

sam-l: Good catch on artifact checksum. Is the re-sync expected to be fast? Any customers impacted still?

support-anna: Emily-C reports one large customer (AcmeCorp) still seeing intermittent 502s; they're on dedicated capacity that pinned those affected hosts. CS is offering mitigation and ETA to AcmeCorp is ~30m.

maya-r: Re-sync started. Expected time ~12m for all replicas. After re-sync complete, we can attempt a controlled rolling reload with `--skip-warmup` disabled for a single canary host to validate.

incident-bot: Pager timeline: page at 18:12 -> acknowledged 18:13 (oncall-mike) -> auto-rollback 18:16 -> artifact re-sync started 18:22

kevin-i: Run this to validate artifact locally on node:
```
sha256sum /mnt/artifacts/turing-xl-v2-quant.bin
model-validate --artifact /mnt/artifacts/turing-xl-v2-quant.bin --check-checksum
```

maya-r: After re-sync finished at 18:35, I performed a canary load with `--skip-warmup` off on host-06-07 and monitored compile timeouts. No compile timeouts, no OOMs for the canary.

oncall-mike: OK moving to recovery phase. Steps for next 30m:
- re-enable warmup one host at a time (canary -> 3 -> remainder) with increased `JIT_TIMEOUT=180s`
- keep traffic on fallback variant until canaries green
- open post-incident ticket to investigate artifact distribution bug

support-anna: CS notes: AcmeCorp will be given full timeline + root cause once we have postmortem. They're asking for logs now; Emily exported relevant request ids.

ops-bot: Automated ticket created: #INC-20260312-081 (artifact-checksum-failure) assigned to maya-r and infra-team.

maya-r: Quick root-cause hypothesis: artifact blobstore returned truncated object for one replica during morning re-sheduling; loader didn't validate checksum early and attempted deserialize leading to EOF then partial memory allocation and JIT compile triggering OOMs.

kevin-i: Follow-up infra actions: add checksum validation on download path, add circuit-breaker to avoid heavy parallel JIT starts if device mem low, and increase default JIT_TIMEOUT for quantized models.

oncall-mike: Declaring incident active -> recovery. Handoff to evening oncall at 1769958000 (18:40 approx). Handoff payload:
- primary: oncall-mike
- summary: model loads failed due to truncated artifact + GPU memory fragmentation causing cudaMalloc OOMs and compile timeouts. Auto-rollback + artifact re-sync + skip-warmup mitigated. One large customer had intermittent 502s; CS notified.
- actions in flight: finish rolling warmup re-enable, follow infra tasks, postmortem ticket INC-20260312-081
- contact: maya-r, kevin-i, support-anna

emily-cs: CS handed off to night team. I'll update AcmeCorp with current mitigation and expected full RCA timeline tomorrow EOD.

oncall-mike: Thanks all. If anything regresses ping me or re-page the incident channel. :thumbsup:

maya-r: Adding note: we'll run `model-validate` as pre-deploy check in CI to catch truncated artifacts before push.

kevin-i: Will follow up with a PR for driver restart playbook and revamp artifact fetcher.

sam-l: Great work. Filing for postmortem. I'll start the notes.

oncall-mike: Handoff complete. last update 1769955178
